cases.title: Line item and participant searches debounce and limit results
steps: Enter several characters quickly in "Search line items".
Enter several characters quickly in "Search participants".
cases.expected: Each search waits for the debounce interval before updating. Intermediate keystrokes do not trigger separate visible searches. Each table displays no more than 20 results on the page.
cases.setup: Use a project with more than 20 line items and more than 20 participants.
gaps: Waiting at least 300 milliseconds before each result update
Proving intermediate keystrokes do not trigger separate visible searches
Proving that each search waits for the debounce interval before updating

cases.title: Project tabs truncate long titles and identify withdrawn stages
steps: Hover over the truncated stage tab.
Review the tab for the inactive stage.
cases.expected: The long tab title is truncated to 20 characters and its tooltip shows the full title. The inactive stage tab carries a "Withdrawn" tag.
cases.setup: Use a project with a stage title longer than 20 characters and an inactive or withdrawn stage.
gaps: Cannot create or reach a project containing a withdrawn stage tab.
Cannot assert that a stage tab is truncated to exactly 20 characters.
Cannot hover a truncated stage tab and assert that its tooltip contains the full title.
Cannot assert that the inactive stage tab carries a Withdrawn tag.

cases.title: Ask Clara starts awarding and redirects to the returned flow
steps: Wait for the action to complete.
cases.expected: The app shows "Awarding initiated successfully, redirecting to awarding flow..." and navigates to the returned redirect_url.
cases.setup: Use a project where the Ask Clara todo is analyze_data. Stub the successful response with a valid redirect_url.
gaps: The dynamic returned redirect_url and navigation to the awarding flow cannot be asserted.
The awarding flow destination screen cannot be named with expect_navigated because awarding is not an available screen value.
